about: Query cases for eval/harness.py. `relevant` is the chunk ids a person says answer the query, read off `embedded.json` for each video -- not off a ranking, which would grade the system against itself. `kind` is verified by `--check`, never trusted: a paraphrase that shares the corpus's wording is a literal case wearing a label.
corpus: 4 videos, 49 units. Chernobyl 9 chunks (clip:archival, clip:hazards, transcript) · slides 4 (text:signage, text:topic) · test1 4 (clip:topic, clip:activity) · test2 3 (yolo:topic, yolo:activity)

cases.query: the RBMK reactor schematic with coolant loops and pumps
cases.why: c3 and c4 are both labelled RBMK-1000 diagrams with coolant piping and pumps

cases.query: a map of Eastern Europe and the Soviet republics
the title card at the very start
cases.why: c0 is the CHERNOBYL 1986 title card
c6 is the accident and containment sequence, c8 the arched containment structure
c5 is the only chunk naming the watermark

cases.query: how is warmth carried away from the middle
cases.why: asks about the coolant diagram without saying RBMK, schematic or loop -- 50% overlap; see `why`

cases.query: the very first thing you see before anything happens
cases.why: the title card, described without title, card or 1986

cases.query: the bit that tells you where in the world
cases.why: the map, without map, Europe or Soviet -- 0% overlap, measured

cases.query: after it went wrong, how did they seal it up
cases.why: containment, without containment, damaged or reactor

cases.query: a bird's eye view of the whole industrial site
cases.why: c2 and c7 are both wide site views with smokestacks

cases.query: the QUARTERLY REVIEW header on the slide
cases.why: every slide chunk carries the header; a sanity case that should be easy

cases.query: what words are written across the top of the page
cases.why: asks for the header without header, slide or quarterly

cases.query: a cashier handling the register at the counter
cases.why: c0 and c2 both name a cashier at the register
c0 and c1 both name the toy shelves
the checkout, without cashier, register or counter -- 33% overlap, measured
the man on a ladder near the coolers, without ladder or cooler -- 50% overlap; the corpus wording is hard to avoid

cases.why: c0 names both the ladder and the coolers
only c2 names the bald person with sunglasses
